family.description: Second and final permitted exploratory resolution pilot for the DVB-T2 ETSI EN 302 755 v1.4.1 SS6.1.3 bit-interleaver family. It repeats only the qam16-r12-short whole-consumer comparator-gap cell at the frozen pilot maximum of 24 fresh pairs because that cell set the accepted ten-cell pilot resolution. The operation, arms, seed, cache state, conversion-inclusive timing method and 1.10/1.20 margins are unchanged. This pilot only supplies resolution evidence and cannot decide adoption.

effect.rationale: Comparator-gap cells only. This issue is a baseline survey: it proposes no production change, so no worthwhile-speedup threshold applies and none is declared.
effect.equivalence_rationale: A 10% equivalence margin, carried unchanged into the confirmatory addendum so the pilot's own decisions are computed under the rule the confirmation uses. Pilot cells never yield a pass; the margin exists here only to make the pilot's recorded decisions comparable.
effect.material_gap_rationale: A 20% whole-consumer wall-clock gap is the smallest gap between two arms of this operation that is worth attributing to a named cause (representation conversion, permutation-table traffic, or codegen level) rather than to host noise on this shared eight-worker machine. The pilot exists to check that this threshold sits above the measured resolution before the confirmatory addendum freezes it.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: A survey adopts nothing. No production kernel changes, so the budget is zero by construction; the whole diff is under dev/.
